title: LASER: Defeasible Certificate Search for Long-Range Protocol Dependencies
abstract: arXiv:2610.14552v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Protocol specifications rarely justify executable behavior in one place: a transition may inherit its source state from a remote control block, name its events only by number, and remain subject to a later correction. Recovering the nearby clause is therefore insufficient; the system must assemble a source-linked certificate and determine whether any stronger rule applies. We introduce LASER, a proof-carrying search method for sparse, defeasible protocol evidence. LASER represents missing support and unresolved corrections as explicit obligations, searches typed evidence routes, and lets an occurrence-aware symbolic checker alone decide whether a certificate warrants, refutes, or leaves a behavior unresolved. translated_title: LASER：面向长程协议依赖的可废止证书搜索
translated_abstract: 协议规范很少在单一位置对可执行行为给出完整论证：某个状态转移可能从远程控制块继承其源状态，仅以编号指代其事件，且仍可能受到后续修正条款的约束。因此，仅恢复附近的条款是不够的；系统必须组装出与源码关联的证书，并判定是否有更强的规则适用。我们提出 LASER，一种面向稀疏、可废止协议证据的携带证明搜索方法。LASER 将缺失的支撑与未决的修正表示为显式义务，在类型化的证据路径上进行搜索，并由一个具备出现感知能力的符号检查器单独裁决证书究竟是证实、反驳还是使该行为保持未决。在匹配的 2K 预算下，针对 91 个 BehaviorCheck 家族，LASER 在两个模型家族上将 Joint Edge+Proof 指标相对最强的局部读取器分别提升了（Δ=+.132，p=.017；Δ=+.198，p<.001），同时将错误发现（原文摘要在此处截断，信息不完整）……
tldr: LASER 提出一种携带证明的可废止搜索方法，将缺失支撑与未决修正建模为显式义务，通过搜索类型化证据路径并借助符号检查器裁决，跨越长程协议依赖组装与源码关联的证书，从而提升协议行为验证的准确率并减少误报。
en_tdlr: LASER is a proof-carrying, defeasible search method that represents missing support and unresolved corrections as explicit obligations, searches typed evidence routes across long-range protocol dependencies, and lets an occurrence-aware symbolic checker adjudicate certificates, improving joint edge+proof performance and reducing false discoveries.
